text:
Liam R.: Hey @people-ops — noticed my Nov paycheck had a "Local City Tax" line for $85. I live and now work remotely in Portland since 2024-07-01. Why is a municipality tax for 'San Mateo' being withheld?
Sophia (People Ops): Hi @Liam, sorry about that. Can you paste the paystub snippet or last4 so payroll can pull the record?
Liam R.: Last4 7789. Paystub shows:
```
Payrun: 2024-11-15
EmpID: 7789
Work location: Portland, OR (remote)
Local tax: San Mateo local income tax $85.00
Net pay: $2,415.00
```
Payroll Bot: Ticket created: PAY-4210 assigned to @Henry (Payroll). Priority: standard.
Henry (Payroll): Pulled the file. Payroll system jurisdiction = site_tax: SAN_MATEO because office address in HR record was not deactivated after Facilities changed office code to PORTLAND-REMOTE. Looks like an address mapping mismatch between HR and Facilities -> payroll integration.
Henry (Payroll): Plan: 1) reverse local-tax withholding in next reversal batch to restore net pay 2) process off-cycle adjustment to reissue funds (if remittance not yet sent to municipal collector) or payroll credit and then handle reclaim if remitted 3) update the HR location flag and run a short audit for other employees flagged SAN_MATEO but with remote state OR.
Facilities: We did update seating/desk inventory but apparently didn't flip the 'primary-office' attribute for remote-only reassignments. Apologies — we'll run a backfill of office flags for July onwards.
Local Tax Team: Note: some municipalities require employer remittance within 7 days; if already remitted we may need to file a refund request with the city. Best UX is payroll credit for the employee and Tax will pursue the municipal reclaim. If payroll credit isn't possible quickly, provide docs so employee can claim on local return.
Sophia (People Ops): Action items:
 @Henry start the reversal and off-cycle plan (PAY-4210)
 @Facilities backfill the HR office flag for remote reassignments (since 2024-07-01)
 @Local Tax Team advise on municipal reclaim steps and timing
Henry (Payroll): ETA: reversal submitted in 2 business days, off-cycle credit within 5 business days after reversal. I will also add a note to Liam's record explaining the correction and the expected W-2/local box impact at year-end.
Liam R.: Appreciate the quick action. Please cc me on PAY-4210 and any docs I need to file.
Henry (Payroll): Will do. Ill update here when reversal posts. :thumbsup:
